AMENDMENT (pre-grill, from the adversarial review of the idea set). Six changes — the first two are why this contract must not be built as written:
(1) THE RULE IT GENERALIZES IS DEAD CODE. AC-3 extends high-impact-defaulted, but that rule reads contract.openQuestions (src/flow/validators/rules.ts:240) while v14 made openQuestions a TOP-LEVEL SIBLING of the contract (journey-format-spec §2; the writer, store.ts:1556-1569) — so it can never fire on a real node, and the suite cannot catch it because its test hand-writes the pre-v14 nested shape (src/flow/__tests__/validators.test.ts:77-81). Its presence check is also not per-question (rules.ts:243 passes if ANY evidence carries ANY answers). AMEND AC-3: this task FIRST fixes the field path and makes the match PER QUESTION, and only then generalizes — otherwise it generalizes an excuse.
(2) THE SIGNAL IT KEYS ON IS NEVER SET. materialize.ts:140 derives impact from q.blocking, and every live openQuestion is blocking:false (this contract's own Q1/Q2 included); blocking is enforced only at the frame (frame.ts:199), so authoring practice routes around it. AMEND: name WHO may set blocking and HOW it is set at spawn, or the generalized rule keys on a field nothing populates.
(3) IT MUST CONSUME 12/08's DERIVATION, NOT RE-OPEN IT. Choice points include gate decisions, and gateLifecycle/workflowState (src/store/workflow.ts) is the ONE derivation. This contract names no input pointing at it, so as written it permits re-opening the exact twelve-reader sin 12/08 closed. AMEND: declare it as input/reference and state 'consume, never re-scan the triple'.
(4) AC-1 MUST COVER THE FRAME'S PATH. frame.ts:331 calls commands.gate(..., decision.feedback ?? '') and the frame asks for a why only on REJECT (frame.ts:349-352) — so a required why would break the frame's own confirm accept, and 12/11 AC-5 promises no regression against a path its own AC-1 breaks. 13 of the 19 bare accepts are confirm-gate accepts. AMEND: the frame ASKS for the why on confirm accept too, in the same commit.
(5) AC-1 CONTRADICTS AC-4. The read is designed to display a missing why honestly; the write refuses to record one — so 'I don't know why' is a first-class historical state and an unrepresentable new one. AMEND: make the absence explicitly recordable (a named why-unknown provenance) instead of forcing an inferred sentence.
(6) THE WHY'S TRANSPORT FROM A SESSION. 12/09 AC-4 forbids the session writing a gate event; its oracle wants the session to end with the human's why on the record. AMEND: a session DRAFTS the why; the human's gesture records it (the session never writes the decision).
ALSO: flow-control-spec §3 fixes what the gates collect ('accept | reject + feedback') but is not among this contract's requiredInputs — add it or the amendment is undeclared. And in the same one-derivation class, the review found the live engine still answering one question twice in a single read: ann next prints 'leg gate: MET' AND 'leg gate UNMET: 4 done, 9 blocked' (legGateMet, store.ts:1848 vs the empty-ready-set branch, commands/index.ts:1421) — that repair is spawned as 12/14, this task must not duplicate it.

WORK DONE AHEAD OF THE ENTRY GATE — the operator's direct instruction, 2026-09-19; recorded as an ANOMALY (the flow puts the entry grill before the work), not as the flow. AC-3's PREREQUISITE landed at 27efa75: high-impact-defaulted now reads the v14 TOP-LEVEL openQuestions through ONE accessor (store.openQuestions, shared with the packet assembler — the duplicate read is gone), matches PER QUESTION via evidence.answers[].id, and flags any answer whose provenance is not discussed (the tech-stack lesson the rule's own definition states). Its test now writes the LIVE shape; the old one hand-wrote the pre-v14 nested shape, which is why the suite could not catch the dead field path. Verified: 851 tests green · typecheck clean · ann validate on the live journey reports only distance-to-goal (0 live blocking questions, so no new findings). REMAINING SCOPE this note does NOT claim: the decisions derivation + its read, the required why on the confirm accept (CLI + card + the FRAME's own path, frame.ts:331), the why-unknown escape, and the high-impact generalization to gate accepts.
